occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Emergency Practices documentation was reviewed. It was noted that the last fire drill, recorded on the log sheet, took place on June 9, 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: Annual Training documentation provided by the Primary Caregiver did not meet the requirement of 30 hours on an annual basis.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver did not have updated first aid, it expired 9/14/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary caregiver did not have updated CPR, it expired 9/14/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 5 out of 11 children's records evaluated did not contain the following information:    1. Special Needs Statement  2. Address of Emergeny Contacts  3. Name, Phone number and address of the Emergency physician or facility.

Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months: Documentation of training in the following topics for the Primary Caregiver was not available for review:    1. SIDS, Shaken Baby Syndrome and Early Childhood Brain Development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Special topics for children under 24 months (26 TAC §747.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: The employee list has not been validated since May 4th, 2021 and should've been validated by May 4th, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver does not have current CPR/First Aid training. The certificate reviewed expired on May 23rd, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies did not include the following information:    Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F of this chapter (relating to Developmental Activities and Activity Plan). [Medium] Your policies must include:    (A)The duration of physical activity at your home, both indoor and outdoor    (B)The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities     (C) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
